integrity: Analytical result subject to self-review only; source priority is not independently established. Verification uses symbolic identities and independent finite-dimensional computations, not experimental evidence.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent Poisson multiplicative resets, between-reset Brownian diffusion, and E|A|^4<1. No finite-sample identifiability or general waiting-time theorem. Broad semigroup methods may imply parts of this expression.
title: A universal temporal fourth-order arrow and its cancellation under random-amplitude Brownian resetting
